context_requirements: Expression of MTNR1A and/or MTNR1B melatonin receptors
An intact G-protein-coupled signaling axis downstream of melatonin receptors
A cell context in which melatonin receptor activation couples to transcriptional programs; most common cancer cell lines lack this
falsifiers: Reproducible concentration-dependent changes in landmark gene expression at 6 h or 24 h across multiple cell lines
A shared transcriptional signature across the nine lines that is absent in vehicle controls
Rescue of the signature by a melatonin receptor antagonist
